description: Normalize Kubernetes API audit JSON to ECS

script.source: def action = ctx.event?.action; if (action == 'create') ctx.event.type = ['creation']; else if (action == 'update' || action == 'patch') ctx.event.type = ['change']; else if (action == 'delete' || action == 'deletecollection') ctx.event.type = ['deletion']; else if (action == 'get' || action == 'list' || action == 'watch') ctx.event.type = ['access']; else ctx.event.type = ['info']; ctx.event.category = ['api']; def decision = ctx.annotations == null ? null : ctx.annotations['authorization.k8s.io/decision']; if (decision != null) { ctx.event.outcome = decision == 'allow' ? 'success' : 'failure'; ctx.event.type.add(decision == 'allow' ? 'allowed' : 'denied'); } def reason = ctx.annotations == null ? null : ctx.annotations['authorization.k8s.io/reason']; if (reason != null && reason.length() > 0) ctx.event.reason = reason; def extra = ctx.user == null ? null : ctx.user.extra; if (extra != null) { def pod = extra['authentication.kubernetes.io/pod-name']; def uid = extra['authentication.kubernetes.io/pod-uid']; if (pod != null || uid != null) { if (ctx.kubernetes == null) ctx.kubernetes = new HashMap(); if (ctx.kubernetes.audit == null) ctx.kubernetes.audit = new HashMap(); if (ctx.kubernetes.audit.actor == null) ctx.kubernetes.audit.actor = new HashMap(); if (ctx.kubernetes.audit.actor.pod == null) ctx.kubernetes.audit.actor.pod = new HashMap(); if (pod != null && !pod.isEmpty()) ctx.kubernetes.audit.actor.pod.name = pod[0]; if (uid != null && !uid.isEmpty()) ctx.kubernetes.audit.actor.pod.uid = uid[0]; } }

if (ctx.related == null) ctx.related = new HashMap(); if (ctx.user?.name != null) ctx.related.user = [ctx.user.name]; if (ctx.source?.ip != null) ctx.related.ip = ctx.source.ip instanceof List ? ctx.source.ip : [ctx.source.ip];
